title: The XLSX value-only editor's element, attribute and relationship allow-lists become one dependency rule, and the source-backed publication audit stops refusing a replacement that carries its source's formatting
decision: retained, implemented in litchi-xlsx and litchi-opc
code_state: crates/litchi-xlsx and seven paired replacement-audit call sites in crates/litchi-opc/src/source_backed.rs; no public API item added, removed or changed; no new unsafe and no new dependency; MAX_XML_DEPTH's visibility widened to pub(crate) with its value unchanged; xml-minifier untouched (change 0654's verify_source is reused)
reason_codes: decision 7 of change 0652 authorizes 0602's D4: unfamiliar elements and attributes are copied through unchanged, and the dependency rule decides which constructs an edit must understand

the allow-lists were a proxy for a property the rewrite already has: it composes the dimension ref attribute and the sheetData span and copies every other byte, so an element outside those spans can be admitted without the editor learning anything about it

attributes need no list at all, because write_tag re-emits the source tag of every element the writer touches and replaces only the attributes it owns; the one exception, a relationship reference inside sheetData, is refused directly because a removed cell record would orphan it
the corpus census is the measurement: 0 of 95 packages and 0 of 208 worksheet parts admitted before, 10 and 15 after, twelve fixtures changing verdict and none regressing

four dependency verdicts (protected sheet, covering data validation, covering group formula, covered merge) were already implemented in the raw editor's layout scan and had never been reachable through this door

D2 (the shared-string table) is deliberately not implemented: it is a construct the editor would have to model rather than an unfamiliar element copied through, decision 7 does not name it, and it carries 0602's F3 resource falsification

change 0654's finding 5 recorded that loosening the original-bytes audit alone leaves the value editor refused, because its replacement carries the source's formatting verbatim; the wave's reading of decision 2 is that compactness is not a publication refusal on any route, only a test-time property of this library's serializers

the row-visibility editor keeps its own narrower admission, because a protected sheet, an autofilter, a sort state, a custom sheet view and markup-compatibility content are dependencies of a visibility edit even though they are not dependencies of a value edit

the four producer-shaped source scenarios beat a 2.31% A/A floor at p50 while the two marker-free controls stay at a quarter of it or less, which is what distinguishes the effect from binary layout; it does not appear in the instruction counts, so it is reported as evidence and not registered

accepted_evidence.admission_census: a scratch probe, change 0602's xlsx-admission-probe with parts and roundtrip subcommands added, over the 95 real .xlsx fixtures under test-data/ooxml/xlsx and test-data/office-interop on both legs, reporting the editor's verdict per package through both doors and per worksheet part
accepted_evidence.second_gate_census: all 95 fixtures re-censused on the base checkout with the package-root relationships reduced to the officeDocument owner alone, which still admits 0, establishing that the gates behind the first one are what refuse the corpus
accepted_evidence.republication: probe roundtrip comparing the published archive against the source member by member on uncompressed bytes; on the real corpus nothing publishes, and on a whitespace-compacted derivation of the ten admitted packages 8 of 8 differ in exactly xl/workbook.xml and xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml with 0 added and 0 removed
accepted_evidence.edited_part_shape: per published package, the edited worksheet part's common prefix and suffix and its differing middle: exactly one contiguous range on all eight
accepted_evidence.determinism: five packages republished by two separate probe processes, byte-identical
accepted_evidence.witnesses: 23 tests in crates/litchi-xlsx/src/cell_values/admission_tests.rs, one per construct of the rule, each building the smallest package carrying exactly that construct
accepted_evidence.differential: the frozen owned-reference validator loop in validation_borrow_tests.rs, carrying the same copied-subtree state, compared against the borrowed traversal on every fixture including a full truncation sweep
accepted_evidence.corpus_oracles: change 0603's marker-admission oracle and change 0622's facts oracle, both over every real worksheet part, both unchanged
accepted_evidence.instructions: callgrind isolation pairs at --samples 2 and 42 differenced and divided by 40, on change 0601's producer-shaped corpora, both legs at ceb0571a8; the changed module's inclusive Ir per operation beside the whole-operation count; and the publication audit attributed separately
accepted_evidence.timing: paired A1 B1 B2 A2 legs, 20 warm-ups and 30 samples per leg, four windows, every process pinned to CPU 12, with a pre-declared per-leg admission rule (a leg counts only if p95/p50 <= 1.05, a pair only when both its legs are clean) and an A/A floor of 2.31% over 37 clean same-binary comparisons in the same windows; two rounds, the quoted one having a byte-identical harness in both legs

accepted_costs.admission_is_wider: this change is not value-identical: inputs that were refused are now admitted, which is the point of the decision it implements; every input admitted before is admitted after with the same output bytes, and every input refused after is refused with a typed error named in the record
accepted_costs.moved_refusal_points: three refusals move without changing type: cell metadata refuses at validate_scalar_cells instead of the attribute list, merge markup before sheetData refuses in the raw parser instead of the element list, and a refused worksheet relationship names its type instead of refusing all of them at once; each has a witness
accepted_costs.new_depth_bound: the validator now carries the raw parser's own MAX_XML_DEPTH, because a copied subtree may nest as deeply as the input says where the old vocabulary admitted five levels; the parser refuses on the same input, so nothing the pipeline would accept is refused
accepted_costs.merge_guard_duplication: require_unmerged_target repeats at staging a refusal the raw layout scan already makes at commit, so the merge verdict is observable at the same phase as the insert verdict; both produce the identical typed error
accepted_costs.not_byte_minimal_inside_the_edited_tag: write_cell re-orders the edited cell's attributes and drops an explicit t="n"; pre-existing behaviour in code this change does not touch, semantically identical, and visible for the first time because real packages are now admitted
accepted_costs.publication_contract: the source-backed topology and overlay routes no longer refuse a replacement for non-compact XML; every other check stays on both sides, and two tests that pinned the old behaviour are rewritten to pin the new one
accepted_costs.error_order_fixtures: five of change 0541's frozen fixtures used constructs this change admits as their validator-error marker; each is re-pointed at a construct the validator still owns so the property stays tested, and the three moved refusals are pinned at their new point
accepted_costs.timed_binary_predates_two_edits: the timed after binary is commit 3e95c7fa2; the two changes made after it are a module documentation comment in row_visibility and the harness census fix, neither of which runs on the measured path, and the second round measured the census fix explicitly

known_gaps.publication: resolved with change 0654 rather than deferred; the remaining refusals on the corpus are the value-dependent constructs, not the audit
known_gaps.shared_strings: 66 of the 95 refuse on the shared-string relationship; admitting them is 0602's D2 and needs its own record with a bounded, lazily materialized table, index identity as an invariant, and F3 measured on a large table
known_gaps.tables_and_pivot_caches: refused wholesale rather than per-address; a table whose header row the edit does not touch could in principle be admitted, which needs the table part modelled
known_gaps.calcchain_branch_on_the_corpus: no package in the compacted corpus carries an xl/calcChain.xml, so the chain-removal branch of the republication expectation is exercised by a unit witness and not by the corpus
known_gaps.single_worksheet_door: 0602's D5 is untouched; the edit and snapshot doors still require exactly one worksheet
known_gaps.corpus_scope: the admission counts are of this corpus on this host; nothing is claimed for producer files outside it
known_gaps.eager_route: the eager PackageWriter route's authored-part audit is change 0665's and is untouched here

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, allocation, peak-RSS, cold-cache, concurrency or cross-platform result
any claim that a real producer package round-trips through publication today
any claim about shared-string workbooks, pivot workbooks, table-bearing worksheets or multi-sheet single-door edits
